summary: Vehicle off the side of Hwy 82 at mile marker 62, just inside Lake County near the Independence Pass summit, ~500 ft down the hillside; had been there since the previous night. Two occupants trapped with critical injuries, each airlifted by Flight For Life. Pass closed both directions ~12:30-3:45 PM for helicopter operations.
location: Mile marker 62, Colorado State Highway 82 at the Independence Pass summit (vehicle ~500 ft down the hillside)
notes: Physically in Lake County (MM 61 is the Pitkin/Lake boundary); Pitkin County agencies + MRA responded under mutual aid and PCSO posted the release.
